scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,auth,enrollment,grade,profile "npm run dev -w @enrollment/frontend" "npm run dev -w @enrollment/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @enrollment/enrollment-service" "npm run dev -w @enrollment/grade-service" "npm run dev -w @enrollment/profile-service"
scripts.mongo:logs: docker compose logs -f mongo1 mongo2 mongo3
scripts.mongo:replica-status: docker exec enrollment-mongo1 mongosh --port 27117 --quiet --eval "rs.status().members.map(m => ({ name: m.name, state: m.stateStr }))"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:enrollment" "npm run dev:grade" "npm run dev:profile"
